layouts.page_structure: Multi-page immersive experience. Scroll-driven sections acting as scenes. Uses an absolute/fixed 3D canvas background (React Three Fiber) with standard HTML/Tailwind DOM overlaid using pointer-events-none on containers and pointer-events-auto on interactive UI.

grids.magazine: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-12 px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24 py-24
grids.hud_overlay: absolute inset-0 p-8 flex flex-col justify-between

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-12, p-24. Large negative space to allow the 3D marine models and volumetric lighting to breathe.

image_urls.description: Bioluminescent jellyfish texture, use for blending in AI explainability panels or subtle background grain.
Dark underwater blue tone, can be used for fallback background if WebGL fails.

imagery_and_textures.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for crisp, technical HUD icons (e.g., Target, Activity, Zap, Droplet, Radio). No generic SVGs. Stroke width 1.5px.
imagery_and_textures.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 10-15%) over the entire page to give it a cinematic, underwater camera feel.

steps: 1. Setup global Lenis for smooth scroll (crucial for scroll-driven animations).
2. Setup fixed <Canvas> in background, using R3F.
3. Use Drei's <Environment> for reflections, and <Caustics> + volumetric spot lights (with angle and penumbra) for the sun rays penetrating the water.
4. Implement marine snow using a custom particle system (InstancedMesh or Points with additive blending) drifting slowly upwards.
5. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to tie the R3F camera position (y and z axes) to the window scroll position, simulating 'diving' through the 6 ocean layers.
6. Build the DOM UI layers (HTML over Canvas) using Framer Motion for entrance animations and the HUD glassmorphism styling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Awwwards-level polish: Typography, generous spacing, and the interplay of glass UI over rich 3D backgrounds.
Do not use generic UI cards. Use the 'premium_glass_panel' or 'ai_hud_glass' recipes.
The 3D canvas must remain fixed in the background while HTML content scrolls.
Ensure high contrast for text (white/cyan) against the deep navy ocean backgrounds.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive HUD buttons, timeline nodes, and navigation links.
All animations should feel fluid, oceanic, and cinematic (use the specified easing).
Never use `transparent` directly on components containing text. Always use a glassmorphism backdrop.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
